summary.en: China's coast guard and navy are still monitoring Philippine supply missions to a grounded vessel at Ren'ai Jiao and are shadowing a U.S. warship near a disputed shoal, prompting the Philippines to summon China's ambassador over threatening remarks. Vice Admiral Rommel Supangan led the Philippine Coast Guard in rescuing four people, including a child, on Hagonoy Island, Surigao del Sur. Taiwan's coast guard and maritime forces repelled sixteen mainland Chinese ships near the Pratas Islands. The United States and the Philippines conducted their sixteenth bilateral maritime exercise in the West Philippine Sea. 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kystvakten og marinen i Kina overvåker fortsatt filippinske forsyningsoppdrag til et grunnstøtt fartøy ved Ren'ai Jiao og følger et amerikansk krigsskip nær et omstridt skjær, noe som får Filippinene til å innkalle Kinas ambassadør etter truende bemerkninger. Viceadmiral Rommel Supangan ledet Filippinenes kystvakt i redningsaksjonen av fire personer, inkludert et barn, på Hagonoy-øya i Surigao del Sur. Taiwans kystvakt og maritime styrker avverget seksten kinesiske skip nær Pratas-øyene. USA og Filippinene gjennomførte sin sekstende bilaterale maritime øvelse i Vestfilippinske hav. 176 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
